problem: Production Release Readback on exact deploy e648f6c8... timed out waiting for data-bg-pricing-interactions=ready-v3 although the pricing runtime script exists in repository source.
root_cause: The production build runs multiple V18/normalization transforms before pricing-build-integrity restore. The restore only replaced the #pakketten section from the pre-build snapshot. The canonical inline pricing controller and external rescue runtime live outside that section, so a full-page transform could remove them and the restore did not put them back.
prevention: Pricing build integrity must preserve both canonical pricing content and its interaction runtimes.
After build transforms, restore the canonical #pakketten section, the inline bg-pricing-neno-v1-js controller, and the versioned pricing rescue runtime.
Fail the build if either required pricing runtime is absent after restore.
Production readback must still wait for ready-v3 and execute actual lifecycle, group, billing and language clicks.
Do not treat repository source presence as proof that a build transform preserved runtime assets.
